scope: Declaration inventory only: web-app ui-* roster, standard preset top-level plugins, standard delegation children, and Android disabled entries. This is not an exhaustive inventory of all DSH behaviors, optional bundles, CLI surfaces, or nested non-delegation groups.
evidencePolicy: Each evidence level is a manual, scoped claim. partial records known overlap without certifying equivalence; unverified is explicit. The portable skill, todo and present entries cite executed host composition and behavior checks, not device acceptance. Other entries retain their source-audit status. File existence never upgrades evidence; inventory validation is not feature completion.
